B9 pycore access notice (K7/K6 UX).reason: The shared classifyPycoreAccess (core/integrations/pycore/pycoreAccess.ts; writer grant in requirements section 6, line 142) turns a pycore rejection code into host_forbidden / origin_forbidden / client_key_rejected, with the codes read from the contract (ServiceContract CLIENT_KEY_ERROR_CODES / LOCAL_RPC_ERROR_CODES). Without a code it classifies the page (relay_only off-loopback; origin_not_allowed with the contract dashboard ports), else unreachable. The page-level fallback matters: a 403 to a disallowed origin carries no CORS headers, so the browser never sees its code. The Vortex panels keep failure: PycoreAccess | null and render VortexPycoreNotice (en/zh access.* keys that point to the HTTPS relay); plain network failures keep each panel's unreachable text.
